aiDescription: Replaces the vanilla Shroud and Threat hulls with modified copies that have balanced logistics, flux, and damage stats. Threat vessels include a built-in Fragment Swarm hullmod, while Shroud vessels come with a Shrouded Mantle hullmod. The Maelstrom ship has been fixed to prevent crashes when equipped with beam weapons.
